XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine malfunction indicator light comes on with subsequent 'Have engine checked' warning
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0601 | CONTROL UNIT | INJECTION | START | PART | IGNITION | FAILURE | IGNITION | FAILURE | START-UP | FUNCTION | OPERATION | START | IGNITION | ON | MIL | YELLOW |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Injection control unit

  • Fault: Engine fault light illuminated, with occasional failed starts. Once the engine is running, the vehicle operates normally.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0601 (Control unit memory – Checksum error)

  • Cause: Faulty injection control unit

• Action: Check the condition and proper operation of the injection control unit and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the faulty component showed no visible defects and, following its replacement, the problem was permanently resolved.
    The control unit is located in the engine compartment, on the driver’s side, between the engine and the wheel, on the upper part of the mudguard.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 0.7 hours.
